mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.scan: Scan with your authenticator, or enter the setup key.
mfa.codesNotice: These codes appear only once. Keep them somewhere safe. Each code can be used once.
mfa.mailUnavailable: Email recovery is unavailable until your email is verified and platform email delivery is configured.
mfa.forced: Your account must use two-factor authentication. You can replace or recover your authenticator.
mfa.primaryRequired: Sign in with your password or SSO to continue recovery.
mfa.policyNotice: Bots and internal service credentials keep their existing authentication. Forced policies require a verified administrator email and working email recovery.
mfa.rulesHint: One acr per line; one amr combination per line, with members separated by spaces. Matching is case-sensitive.
mfa.requireAccount: Require this account to use MFA
mfa.grantNotice: Verify account ownership first. The authorization is sent to the verified email; the user still needs to sign in and bind a new authenticator.
mfa.error.FlowExpired: The verification flow expired. Sign in again.
mfa.error.InvalidBrowser: This verification flow belongs to another browser.
mfa.error.InvalidCode: The code is invalid. Try again.
mfa.error.CodeAlreadyUsed: This authenticator code was already used. Wait for the next code.
mfa.error.AttemptsExceeded: Too many failed attempts. Sign in again later.
mfa.error.RateLimited: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
mfa.error.AccountUnavailable: The account or session is no longer available. Sign in again.
mfa.error.PolicyChanged: Security settings changed. Sign in again.
mfa.error.NotApplicable: This operation is not available for this account or flow.
mfa.error.AlreadyEnrolled: An authenticator is already enabled. Use replacement instead.
mfa.error.NotEnrolled: Set up two-factor authentication to continue.
mfa.error.PolicyRequiresMfa: Two-factor authentication is required and cannot be disabled.
mfa.error.PrimaryAuthenticationRequired: Sign in again to verify your primary identity.
mfa.error.StepUpRequired: Verify a local factor again for this operation.
mfa.error.LocalMfaRequired: A local authenticator or recovery code is required.
mfa.error.EmailUnverified: The target email must be verified first.
mfa.error.InvalidRecoveryGrant: This recovery authorization is invalid, expired, or already used.
mfa.error.DependencyUnavailable: Verification is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
mfa.error.DelegationNotAllowed: A full login token cannot be issued for an account that requires MFA.
